news.headline: Real Madrid apologise to China over Mbappé's Mao Zedong comments
news.summary: Real Madrid apologised to the Chinese people on Wednesday after star striker Kylian Mbappé sparked a furious backlash over comments referring to the founding leader of Communist China as a dictator.
